_doc: Desired Cloudflare Pages watch-path config, declarative. Edit + run scripts/cf-pages-sync-watch.sh. Keys are CF Pages project names (as shown in the dashboard / `--list`). Each value's `path_includes` is the full desired list of include-globs. Use `/**` (recursive) for package dirs — `/*` only matches direct children and silently skips deeper changes. Projects in CF Pages with `["*"]` (catch-all) are intentionally omitted here.
